text: dsh-window98-theme 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Windows 98 风格主题插件。Host 入口通过 webServer.tapIndex 将样式注入网页，采用青绿色桌面、银色立体面板、海军蓝强调色、像素字体和经典滚动条外观；Client 入口注册 window98 与 window98-dark 两个主题并即时覆盖主题令牌。适合希望把 DSH 网页界面改成复古 Windows 98 外观的用户。浏览器会从 unpkg.com 获取字体文件。

dsh-window98-theme gives DSH web a Windows 98 look. It injects CSS for teal colors, beveled panels, buttons, inputs, and scrollbars. Its Client entry registers light and dark themes with live token overrides. Fonts load from unpkg.com.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成 Windows 98 的复古外观。
DSH 网页有没有青绿色桌面和立体按钮风格？
Give my DSH web interface a classic Windows 98 look.
dsh-window98-theme 的功能「复古网页皮肤」：通过 webServer.tapIndex 注入 Windows 98 风格 CSS，调整颜色、直角边框、按钮和输入框外观；mode 为 stock 时不生成皮肤样式。
dsh-window98-theme 的功能「亮暗主题选择」：在 DSH 主题服务中注册 window98 与 window98-dark 两个可选主题，并应用对应的颜色令牌。插件启用时自动注册，停止时释放注册与覆盖项。

dsh-window98-theme README · dsh-window98-theme：A faithful **Windows 98 skin** for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI, derived from the classic [98.css](https://jdan.github.io/98.css/) design system.

Teal desktop, silver beveled panels, navy accents, pixelated MS Sans Serif, raised 3-D buttons, sunken text fields, and checkerboard scrollbars — with a matching dark variant ("Win98 night") that keeps the retro bevels on dark gray surfaces.

dsh-window98-theme README · Features：- **Complete token remap** — overrides the full `--dsw-alias-*` design-token layer (≈90 tokens) in both light and dark modes, so every component (buttons, hovers, code blocks, chat bubbles, sidebar, tooltips, scrollbars) follows the Win98 palette.
- **Classic chrome** — 98.css-style beveled buttons (pressed state included), sunken inputs with the original dropdown arrow, beveled `<pre>`/`<fieldset>`, dotted focus outlines, navy `::selection`.
- **Pixelated typography** — loads the 98.css "Pixelated MS Sans Serif" webfont and disables font smoothing for that authentic bitmap look.
- **Checkerboard scrollbars** — the original 98.css checkerboard track, beveled thumb and four arrow buttons.
- **Square corners everywhere** — global `border-radius`/`corner-shape` reset plus modern shadows, blur and transitions removed.
- **Theme picker entries** — registers `window98` (light) and `window98-dark` (night) themes in the DSH theme picker.
- **Careful exclusions** — view tabs, breadcrumb titles, brand pills, badges/chips/tags stay flat, so navigation and headers keep their native look.
- **Instant apply + persistence** — the Client half hot-applies tokens

dsh-window98-theme README · Installation：Requires DeepSeek Harness with the web profile enabled. Install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lffrom0303/dsh-window98-theme
```

Restart `dsh web` for the plugin to take effect.

To remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-window98-theme
```

dsh-window98-theme README · Dynamic plugin (one-click, no install)：You can also use it as a dynamic Cordis plugin without installing anything:

1. Open the dynamic plugin editor in DSH.
2. Paste the whole content of [`plugin.dynamic.js`](plugin.dynamic.js) into the Client code box.
3. Run it — the skin applies immediately and reverts when the plugin stops.

dsh-window98-theme README · Usage：- The skin is applied automatically. Pick `window98` or `window98-dark` in the theme picker to pin a mode.
- To disable the skin for the package form, edit `cordis.patch.yml` and set `config.mode: stock`.

dsh-window98-theme README · Config reference：| Key    | Values               | Default     | Description                       |
| ------ | -------------------- | ----------- | --------------------------------- |
| `mode` | `window98` / `stock` | `window98`  | Enable or disable the skin        |

dsh-window98-theme README · How it works：- **Host half (`index.js`)** — registers a `webServer.tapIndex` transform through the official seam; every served `index.html` gets a `<style id="dsh-window98-theme">` block with the full skin (token maps for `html body` light and `html body[data-ds-dark-theme]` dark, plus the chrome CSS).
- **Client half (`client.js`)** — the official web-shell closure factory; registers the two themes and hot-applies the core 13-token override layer through the theme service (`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`), so switching takes effect without a reload.
- **Dynamic form (`plugin.dynamic.js`)** — the same skin as a single self-contained Client function body using `theme.register` + `theme.overrideTokens` + `styles.insert`.
dsh-window98-theme README · How it works：The design follows 98.css values: teal `#008080`, silver `#c0c0c0`, dialog gray `#d4d0c8`, navy `#000080`, bevel shadows `#dfdfdf`/`#808080`/`#0a0a0a`.

dsh-window98-theme README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness web profile (tested on the current `dsh web` release line).
- Chromium-based browsers for the checkerboard/arrow scrollbar chrome (other browsers fall back to token-colored scrollbars).
- Node `>= 22.19.0` for the package form.
dsh-window98-theme README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)

dsh-window98-theme README · Links：- [98.css](https://jdan.github.io/98.css/) — the original Windows 98 design system
- [Other DSH theme plugins](https://github.com/BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin) — the reference architecture this repo follows

dsh-window98-theme README · dsh-window98-theme：给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面做的 **Windows 98 复古皮肤**，忠实还原 [98.css](https://jdan.github.io/98.css/) 设计语言。

teal 绿桌面、银色立体面板、海军蓝强调色、像素化 MS Sans Serif 字体、立体浮雕按钮、凹陷输入框、棋盘格滚动条——并提供配套的暗色变体（「Win98 夜间版」，深灰底 + 银色立体边）。

dsh-window98-theme README · 特性：- **完整令牌映射**——覆盖全部 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌（约 90 个）的亮/暗两套值，按钮、悬浮态、代码块、聊天气泡、侧栏、tooltip、滚动条全部统一到 Win98 色板。
- **经典组件质感**——98.css 风格浮雕按钮（含按下凹陷态）、凹陷输入框 + 原版下拉箭头、`<pre>`/`<fieldset>` 立体边框、点状聚焦框、海军蓝选区。
- **像素字体**——加载 98.css 的 Pixelated MS Sans Serif 字体并关闭字体平滑，还原位图时代观感。
- **棋盘格滚动条**——98.css 原版棋盘格轨道、浮雕滑块与四个方向箭头按钮。
- **全局直角化**——清零圆角与 corner-shape，移除现代阴影、毛玻璃与过渡动画。
- **主题选择器**——注册 `window98`（亮色）与 `window98-dark`（夜间）两个可选主题。
- **精细排除**——视图标签、面包屑标题、品牌药丸、徽章/胶囊/标签保持扁平，导航与头部不受浮雕影响。
- **即时生效 + 持久化**——Client 半边通过主题服务热更新令牌（无需刷新）；Host 半边把完整样式注入每次 `index.html` 响应，刷新后依然生效。

dsh-window98-theme README · 安装：需要启用了 web 配置的 DeepSeek Harness。从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lffrom0303/dsh-window98-theme
```

重启 `dsh web` 生效。

移除：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-window98-theme
```

dsh-window98-theme README · 动态插件（一键使用，无需安装）：也可以直接当动态 Cordis 插件使用：

1. 打开 DSH 的动态插件编辑器；
2. 把 [`plugin.dynamic.js`](plugin.dynamic.js) 的完整内容粘贴到 Client 代码框；
3. 运行——皮肤立即生效，停止插件即还原。

dsh-window98-theme README · 实现原理：- **Host 半边（`index.js`）**——通过官方 `webServer.tapIndex` 接缝注册转换，每次 `index.html` 响应都会注入 `<style id="dsh-window98-theme">`（含亮色 `html body` 与暗色 `html body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 的完整令牌映射 + 组件样式）。
- **Client 半边（`client.js`）**——官方 web-shell 闭包工厂形态；注册两个主题，并通过主题服务（`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`）热应用核心 13 令牌覆盖层，切换无需刷新。
- **动态形态（`plugin.dynamic.js`）**——同一套皮肤的单文件自包含 Client 函数体，使用 `theme.register` + `theme.overrideTokens` + `styles.insert`。
dsh-window98-theme README · 实现原理：配色遵循 98.css 原值：teal `#008080`、银色 `#c0c0c0`、对话框灰 `#d4d0c8`、海军蓝 `#000080`、立体边 `#dfdfdf`/`#808080`/`#0a0a0a`。

- 棋盘格/箭头滚动条需要 Chromium 系浏览器（其他浏览器回退为令牌配色的滚动条）。
- 包形态要求 Node `>= 22.19.0`。
